title: Townsend Brown born in Zanesville, built wireless telegraph as a boy

tellings.quote: was born in 1905. And there's there newspaper, you know, clippings of him creating, you know, wireless Telegram basically at the age of 12 or something.

plain: Thomas Townsend Brown, an inventor whom Michels presents as a scientist who built flying-saucer-like devices for the government, was born in Zanesville, Ohio, in 1905 and was already building a wireless telegraph at about age 12. Michels says there are old newspaper clippings showing the boy and his invention.
